units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 38a:14">Snh. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>למלך שבנה פלטרין גדולים ושִׁיכְלְלָן וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) like a king who built great palaces and decorated them, and made arrangements therein for a large banquet &c.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 2:1">Pesik. R. s. 2</cite> <he>אין אתה מְשַׁכְלְלוֹ</he> thou shalt not finish it (the Temple), opp. <he>מיסדו</he> laying the foundation; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 144">Yalk. Sam. 144</cite>; a. e.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10">Gen. R. s. 10</cite> (ref. to <he>ויכלו</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 2:1">Gen. II, 1</cite>) <he>נִשְׁתּכְלְלוּ השמים בחמה … ונִשְׁתַּכְלְלָה הארץ וכ׳</he> the heavens were decorated with sun, moon, and stars, and the earth with trees and herbs, and with the garden of Eden; Yalk. ib. 15 <he>נִתְכַּלְּלוּ … ונִתְכַּלְּלָה</he>.

senses.gloss: to be founded. Tanḥ. K’doshim 10 (ref. to מכלל, Ps. L, 2) מציון נש׳ כל וכ׳ from Zion was the whole world founded, as we have learned (Y. Yoma V, 42ᶜ), why is it called foundation stone? &c., v. שְׁתִיָּה II.
